name: Adventure fantasy
help: A party on a quest, someone paying for it, someone in the way, and a rival company after the same prize.

outer.label: The party
outer.stance_hint: Why they set out, and what they think finishing will give them

outer.label: The patron
outer.stance_hint: What the quest is really for, from the one paying

outer.label: The villain
outer.stance_hint: What they want the prize for, and why it feels right to them

outer.label: The rival company
outer.stance_hint: Why they think the prize should be theirs

name: Political fantasy
help: Four powers, each sure the realm should run its way. Split the hero's side first, then the main opponent's.

outer.label: The throne
outer.stance_hint: The order it thinks holds the realm together

outer.label: The rebels
outer.stance_hint: The freedom it thinks the realm is owed

outer.label: The temple
outer.stance_hint: The higher law it answers to

outer.label: The old houses
outer.stance_hint: The rights and blood it thinks come first

name: Heist or crime
help: A crew, a mark, the law, and a rival outfit. The crew agrees on the score and fights over what it's worth.

outer.label: The crew
outer.stance_hint: What the score will set right for them

outer.label: The mark
outer.stance_hint: Why they think what they have is theirs to keep

outer.label: The law
outer.stance_hint: What they think catching the crew protects

outer.label: The rival outfit
outer.stance_hint: Why they want the same score

name: Thriller or spy
help: An agency, the enemy service, a hidden player and the press. Inside the agency, how clean the work stays is the fight.

outer.label: The agency
outer.stance_hint: What it thinks it keeps safe

outer.label: The enemy service
outer.stance_hint: What it thinks it's defending

outer.label: The hidden player
outer.stance_hint: What they gain while the others fight

outer.label: The press
outer.stance_hint: Why they think the public should know

name: War
help: Our side, the enemy, command and the civilians caught between. The unit fights over who it follows.

outer.label: The unit
outer.stance_hint: What they're fighting for, as they'd put it

outer.label: The enemy
outer.stance_hint: Why their side thinks it's right

outer.label: Command
outer.stance_hint: What winning the war means from far away

outer.label: The civilians
outer.stance_hint: What they need to come out of it with

name: Space opera or sci-fi
help: A ship or colony, an empire, something alien or artificial, and rebels. The crew or council splits on how to survive.

outer.label: The ship
outer.stance_hint: What keeps them flying, and what they're flying toward

outer.label: The empire
outer.stance_hint: The order it brings and why it thinks that's a gift

outer.label: The other
outer.stance_hint: What the alien or the machine wants, in its own terms

outer.label: The rebels
outer.stance_hint: What they'd tear the empire down for

name: Western or frontier
help: A town, the outlaws, the baron and the law. The town agrees it should survive and fights over how.

outer.label: The town
outer.stance_hint: What a decent place to live means to them

outer.label: The outlaws
outer.stance_hint: Why they think the land owes them

outer.label: The baron
outer.stance_hint: What he thinks progress is

outer.label: The law
outer.stance_hint: What a badge means out here

name: Horror
help: The monster, the survivors, the believers and a skeptical authority. The survivors all want out and fight over how.

outer.label: The monster
outer.stance_hint: What it wants, or what it is

outer.label: The survivors
outer.stance_hint: Getting out alive, and who they'll save

outer.label: The believers
outer.stance_hint: What they think the monster is owed

outer.label: The authorities
outer.stance_hint: The normal they think they're protecting

name: Mystery
help: The detective, the killer, the police and the victim's circle. Everyone in the circle had a reason, and each hides something else.

outer.label: The detective
outer.stance_hint: Why the truth matters to them

outer.label: The killer
outer.stance_hint: Why it had to happen, as they see it

outer.label: The police
outer.stance_hint: What closing the case is for

outer.label: The victim's circle
outer.stance_hint: What they all wanted from the victim

name: Noir
help: The investigator, the client, the mob and the law that's been bought. The client's circle shares a motive and hides different things.

outer.label: The investigator
outer.stance_hint: The line they still won't cross

outer.label: The client
outer.stance_hint: What they say they want, and what they really want

outer.label: The mob
outer.stance_hint: The order they keep, their way

outer.label: The bought law
outer.stance_hint: What they tell themselves the money is for

name: Family drama
help: The family, the board, a buyer and the press. Think of the succession fights in prestige TV: everyone wants the company, each a different way.

outer.label: The family
outer.stance_hint: What the name and the money mean to them

outer.label: The board
outer.stance_hint: What they think the company is for

outer.label: The buyer
outer.stance_hint: What they'd make of it

outer.label: The press
outer.stance_hint: What they think the public is owed

name: Romance
help: The lead, the love interest, a rival and an obstacle. The lead's friends and family all want them happy and disagree on what that means.

outer.label: The lead
outer.stance_hint: What they think love has to look like

outer.label: The love interest
outer.stance_hint: What they're protecting by keeping their distance

outer.label: The rival
outer.stance_hint: Why they think they're the better match

outer.label: The obstacle
outer.stance_hint: The duty, distance or past that stands in the way

name: Coming-of-age
help: The hero, their friends, the adults and a rival clique. The friends all want to grow up and disagree on what that means.

outer.label: The hero
outer.stance_hint: Who they think they're meant to be

outer.label: The friends
outer.stance_hint: What staying close is worth

outer.label: The adults
outer.stance_hint: The future they want for the hero

outer.label: The rival clique
outer.stance_hint: What being on top proves

name: Sports or workplace
help: The team, a rival team, management and pressure from outside. The team wants to win and argues over what a win is.

outer.label: The team
outer.stance_hint: What a win would prove

outer.label: The rival team
outer.stance_hint: Why they think they deserve it more

outer.label: Management
outer.stance_hint: What the numbers have to show

outer.label: Outside pressure
outer.stance_hint: What the fans, the market or the family expect

name: Superhero team
help: The team, the villain, the government and the public. The team agrees on protecting people and fights over how.

outer.label: The team
outer.stance_hint: Who they think they protect

outer.label: The villain
outer.stance_hint: The world they'd make, and why it's better to them

outer.label: The government
outer.stance_hint: What control over powers is meant to keep safe

outer.label: The public
outer.stance_hint: What they want from people with powers

name: Ensemble comedy
help: The group, the boss, a rival group and an outsider. The group wants things to go well and can't agree what well means.

outer.label: The group
outer.stance_hint: What a good day looks like to them

outer.label: The boss
outer.stance_hint: What they think keeps the place running

outer.label: The rival group
outer.stance_hint: Why they think they're the better crowd

outer.label: The outsider
outer.stance_hint: What they see that the group can't

name: Procedural (legal, medical)
help: The firm or ward, the other side, administration and the clients. Everyone wants the case won or the patient saved, at different prices.

outer.label: The firm
outer.stance_hint: What they think the work is for

outer.label: The other side
outer.stance_hint: Why they think they're in the right

outer.label: Administration
outer.stance_hint: What keeps the doors open

outer.label: The clients
outer.stance_hint: What they need, which isn't always what they ask for

name: Four-corner web
help: One dilemma with no clean answer, and four people living it different ways. Write the dilemma as the square's question.

outer.label: Main
outer.stance_hint: The hero's answer to the dilemma

outer.label: Challenger
outer.stance_hint: The other answer, lived well

outer.label: Comforter
outer.stance_hint: Someone who agrees with the hero, and why that's risky

outer.label: Warning
outer.stance_hint: Where the hero's answer leads if nothing changes
